run_measure_visual_fidelity: run the script to calculate FID and KID metrics comparing simulated and real image directories
build_visual_fidelity_cli: build a CLI tool that computes Fréchet Inception Distance and Kernel Inception Distance between two image sets
test_measure_visual_fidelity: test the measure_visual_fidelity function by passing args with sim_path and real_path pointing to image directories
refactor_measure_visual_fidelity: refactor measure_visual_fidelity to return metrics as a dictionary instead of printing them directly
summarize_measure_visual_fidelity: summarize the measure_visual_fidelity function which uses torch_fidelity to compare visual quality of simulated vs real images
